text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
We have Mia the black cat, Emma the
bear cub,
Nicole the squirrel, and Lola
the elephant...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what do you think would be a good
name?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"For what?" My new stuffed animal's
name, that's
what! It has to sound like a
bunny name, be cute,
and easy to say. ♪
Got it?
